Hey there! We're Juju and Marko, a couple from Belgium and Croatia who love to explore the world. Traveling is for everyone, and we'll show you how to do it on a budget. We'll share our tips and tricks for making the most out of your money, so you can see more without breaking the bank.

We're all about unique experiences and pushing our boundaries. We're always on the lookout for local gems and aren't afraid to step out of our comfort zones. We'll take you on a journey, showing you the real and raw side of traveling, including the challenges and unexpected moments.

So, come join us and explore different countries and cultures with us, one budget-friendly trip at a time. Don't forget to subscribe and hit the notification bell so you never miss an adventure! And if you have any suggestions, let us know!

If you want to support us, you can buy us a tea/coffee 😁
https://www.buymeacoffee.com/DliberatelyLost

Check out our Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/wearedeliberatelylost/
